reproducibility.claim: No author-linked reproducible package was located in the audited official records or exact GitHub repository searches; this is an audit result, not proof that no code exists anywhere.

paper_method_facts.coordinate_normalization: per projected coordinate normalized to [0,1], then denormalized before matrix inverse
paper_method_facts.rank_repair: small random numbers are added when matrix rank is below three

retained_hypothesis: A deterministic SO(3) coordinate frame, full-cube projection normalization and strictly monotone separable curves can form a compact explicit colour operator with an analytic inverse and positive Jacobian. This representation prior is distinct from AL1 input-dependent sector blending.

am1_constraints.coordinate_matrix: deterministic bounded SO(3), condition number exactly one, no random repair
am1_constraints.normalization: derived from the complete RGB cube and the coordinate matrix, never from the current image histogram or extrema
am1_constraints.curves: endpoint-fixed strictly positive-increment monotone curves with a defined analytic inverse
am1_constraints.renderer: coordinate projection, curve evaluation, inverse coordinate projection; no neural final RGB

forbidden: execute or reconstruct the paper network, weights or unlocated code
use the paper's random rank repair
use image extrema or content embeddings to define the coordinate system
treat paired digital retouching or exposure correction as film evidence
fit current real-film pixels, train a router, or claim stock, mode, calibration, preference, severe safety or production readiness
